configs/robovis2027.yaml.content:
# ROBOVIS2027 experiment config (PGSG + resolution-recovery stop policy).
# Plan initial YAML (spec_version 1.0) expanded to block form, plus local paths.
# All relative paths are resolved against the repository root.

spec_version: 1.0

output_root: outputs/robovis2027

dataset:
  vg_root: /home/kanaoka/usr/dataset/vg   # images/, test.json, rel.json (VG-150)
  source_split: test                     # VG-150 test split (== PGSG test split)
  dev_count: 20                          # images after the test block in shuffled order
  test_count: 100                        # first N of shuffled order; truncatable to 60
  seed: 42                               # random.Random(seed).shuffle on sorted ids
  min_gt_objects: 5                      # GT-only eligibility (plan §8)
  min_gt_relations: 3
  base_max_side: 384                     # pre-shrink so max(W,H)=384 (PGSG input is 384x384)

paths:
  root: data/processed/robovis2027
  selected_images: data/processed/robovis2027/selected_images.json
  eligible_ids: data/processed/robovis2027/eligible_ids.json
  selection_manifest: data/processed/robovis2027/selection_manifest.json
  degraded_images: data/processed/robovis2027/degraded_images   # <image_id>/level_XX.jpg
  levels_manifest: data/processed/robovis2027/levels_manifest.json
  miru_selected_images: data/processed/selected_images.json     # old MIRU 100 (read-only)

resolution:
  # Must equal configs/config.yaml resolution_levels.scales (asserted in script 27).
  # Geometric schedule scale_t = 0.05 * 20^((t-1)/19), t = 1..20.
  scales:
    - 0.05
    - 0.0585
    - 0.0685
    - 0.0802
    - 0.0940
    - 0.1100
    - 0.1288
    - 0.1508
    - 0.1765
    - 0.2066
    - 0.2419
    - 0.2832
    - 0.3316
    - 0.3882
    - 0.4545
    - 0.5321
    - 0.6229
    - 0.7293
    - 0.8538
    - 1.0
  interpolation: bilinear      # downscale and upscale (and pre-shrink)
  output_format: JPEG
  jpeg_quality: 95             # every level incl. level_20 is re-encoded identically

proposal:
  max_hypotheses: 3
  max_observed_issues: 3
  theta: 2
  consecutive_k: 2
  unknown_conservative_theta: 1   # separately named variant (plan §6)
  max_u: 2                        # u_j = min(basis, benefit) in {0,1,2}; empty graph -> A_t = max_u

evaluation:
  reference: vg_existing_gt
  primary: SGDet_R50
  secondary: SGDet_mR50
  iou_threshold: 0.5
  judge_enabled: false
  bootstrap_repeats: 2000
  bootstrap_seed: 20271007
  ci_level: 0.95
  oracle_ratio: 0.9             # relative-stable oracle: q_u >= ratio * qmax for all u >= t
  oracle_gain_delta: 0.05       # auxiliary gain_based oracle (not used in main results)
  recall_k: 50                  # k of R@k / mR@k (per-predicate sidecar)
  q_metric: R50                 # stage_metrics column used as q_t (R50 | relsg_gt | ...)
  report_q_metrics:             # agreed evaluation metrics (user decision 2026-10-07); report shows only these
    R50: primary
    relsg_gt: secondary
  relsg_top_entities: 20        # GT-RelSGScore cap: top-N entities by score (label set)
  relsg_top_relations: 50       # GT-RelSGScore cap: top-N relations by trp_score (triplet set)
  clean_merge_iou: 0.5          # cleaned observed graph G: same-label entity merge IoU (>)
  clean_top_relations: 20       # cleaned observed graph G: top-K relations by trp_score

execution:
  schema_retries: 1
  transient_retries: 5
  max_model_calls: 9000
  concurrency: 1

pgsg:
  checkpoint: Pix2Grp_CVPR2024/PGSG-CVPR2024/vg_sgg.pth
  env: envs/pgsg
  eval_config: configs/pgsg/rel_det_vg_eval_local.yaml

llm:
  model: qwen3.5:4b
  endpoint: http://localhost:11434/api/chat
  think: false                 # qwen3.5 <think> mode off -> plain JSON output

# Check generator (F1/F2) + judgment (owned by check_generator.py / judge.py).
# Model id, endpoint and think flag come from `llm:` above; retry counts from
# `execution:`; item caps from `proposal:`.
checks:
  check_model: qwen3.5:4b      # F1 (image + graph) and F2 (graph only)
  judge_model: qwen3.5:4b      # text-only judgment
  json_mode: true              # ollama `format: "json"`; false -> plain text + parse
  options:                     # passed verbatim as ollama `options`
    temperature: 0
    seed: 20271007
    num_ctx: 8192
    num_predict: 1536
  request_timeout_s: 300
  retry_temperature: 0.3       # schema retry only (attempt 2); attempt 1 uses options.temperature
  backoff_base_s: 2.0          # transient retry sleep = base * 2^attempt, capped
  backoff_max_s: 30.0
  max_relations_in_prompt: 50  # top-N by trp_score (graph is already sorted)
  max_entities_in_prompt: 60   # entities used by kept relations first, then by score
  max_string_chars: 240
  box_decimals: 2              # normalized box coords in the rendering
  score_decimals: 2
  v2:                          # --prompt-version v2 rendering overrides (F1_v2 / F1v_v2)
    max_relations_in_prompt: 20
    max_entities_in_prompt: 30 # strict cap (v1 always keeps relation endpoints)
    merge_iou: 0.5             # merge same-label entities with box IoU > this
    string_hint_chars: 200     # prompt-only hint; validator keeps max_string_chars
  v4:                          # judge v4 (bbox-grounded visibility, variant F1g_v4_*)
    top_entities: 8            # top-K graph entities by score drawn + listed
    overlay_line_width: 1      # thin rectangle (px, base image)
    overlay_color: [255, 0, 0]
    overlay_font_size: 10

configs/config.yaml.content:
# Milestone 1: Semantic information saturation detection from SGG output
# All paths are relative to repository root (milestone_1/).

paths:
  vg_root: /home/kanaoka/usr/dataset/vg          # images/, train.json, val.json, test.json, rel.json
  vg_split: test                                  # which VG split to draw GT + images from
  egtr_repo: egtr                                 # EGTR submodule (imported, never modified)
  egtr_artifact: egtr/checkpoint/egtr__pretrained_detr__SenseTime__deformable-detr__batch__32__epochs__150_50__lr__1e-05_0.0001__visual_genome__finetune__version_0/batch__64__epochs__50_25__lr__2e-07_2e-06_0.0002__visual_genome__finetune/version_0
  egtr_architecture: SenseTime/deformable-detr
  selected_images: data/processed/selected_images.json
  degraded_images: data/processed/degraded_images
  gt_scene_graphs: data/processed/gt_scene_graphs
  egtr_predictions: outputs/egtr_predictions
  metrics: outputs/metrics
  llm_inputs: outputs/llm_inputs
  llm_scores: outputs/llm_scores
  figures: outputs/figures

dataset:
  name: visual_genome
  num_images: 100           # scaled up after 10-image validation
  min_gt_objects: 5
  min_gt_relationships: 3
  use_person_subset: false
  seed: 42

resolution_levels:
  num_levels: 20
  # Geometric (log-spaced) schedule: scale_t = 0.05 * 20^((t-1)/19), constant
  # ratio r = 20^(1/19) ≈ 1.171 per level (each level +~17% resolution).
  # Rationale: equal RELATIVE resolution gain per level => ~uniform perceptual /
  # information increment (Weber-Fechner / equal log-resolution octave), and
  # corresponds to a constant-fraction ("exponential") approach (distance *= ~0.854
  # per step). Replaces the hand-picked near-linear list whose per-level change was
  # large at low scale and flat (L15+) at high scale.
  scales:
    - 0.05
    - 0.0585
    - 0.0685
    - 0.0802
    - 0.0940
    - 0.1100
    - 0.1288
    - 0.1508
    - 0.1765
    - 0.2066
    - 0.2419
    - 0.2832
    - 0.3316
    - 0.3882
    - 0.4545
    - 0.5321
    - 0.6229
    - 0.7293
    - 0.8538
    - 1.00
  # bilinear downscale/upscale: area-averaging low-pass that matches optical/sensor
  # capture of a distant object (smooth blur, not blocky aliasing). Chosen as the
  # adopted model for "robot approaching -> resolution recovers"; nearest-neighbor
  # results are archived under outputs/runs/nearest/ for comparison.
  interpolation: bilinear

egtr:
  object_conf_threshold: 0.1
  relation_conf_threshold: 0.005
  top_k_objects: 20
  top_k_relationships: 30

metrics:
  sg_score:
    node_weight: 0.5
    relation_weight: 0.5
  sg_score_rel_heavy:
    node_weight: 0.4
    relation_weight: 0.6
  oracle_thresholds: [0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6]
  main_oracle_threshold: 0.5
  gain_epsilon: 0.02
  gain_k: 3

baseline:
  mean_object_conf_threshold: 0.35
  mean_object_conf_thresholds: [0.3, 0.35, 0.4]
  consecutive_k: 1

llm:
  provider: ollama
  model: qwen3.5:4b
  endpoint: http://localhost:11434/api/generate
  start_level: 5
  history_length: 5
  # Recalibrated 0.8 -> 0.70: minimizes LLM-SGG (4b, k=2) MAE vs stop_c09
  # (3.46 -> 3.27); 0.8 stopped too late (mean 15.7 vs oracle ~13.5).
  saturation_threshold: 0.70
  use_consecutive_stop: false
  consecutive_k: 2
  input_object_conf_threshold: 0.3
  input_relation_conf_threshold: 0.005
  input_top_k_objects: 20
  input_top_k_relationships: 30
  request_timeout: 120

# ── Evaluation extensions (VLM baseline / ablation / analysis) ──

# ollama chat endpoint (supports text + images via "images" field, "think": false)
ollama_chat_endpoint: http://localhost:11434/api/chat

vlm:
  # qwen3.5:4b and :9b are both vision-capable -> same model family as the LLM-on-SGG
  # approach, giving a capability-controlled "image vs structured-SG-text" comparison.
  models: [qwen3.5:4b, qwen3.5:9b]
  modes: [single, sequence]      # single = current-level image; sequence = recent history images
  sequence_history: 3            # number of recent level-images for sequence mode (cost-bounded)
  start_level: 5
  saturation_threshold: 0.7
  consecutive_k: 2
  max_image_side: 512            # downscale images sent to VLM for transport speed (blur already baked in)
  request_timeout: 300

ablation:
  # One-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) from this base config; LLM-input factors require new
  # scored runs, post-hoc factors (consecutive_k, sg weights, hybrid) are computed from cache.
  base:
    model: qwen3.5:9b
    history_length: 5
    relation_on: true
    confidence_on: true
  llm_models: [qwen3.5:4b, qwen3.5:9b]       # model-size axis (at base config)
  history_lengths: [1, 3, 5]                  # history axis (at base, 9b)
  relation_on_options: [true, false]          # node-only vs node+relation (at base, 9b)
  confidence_on_options: [true, false]        # include confidences in LLM input (at base, 9b)
  consecutive_k_options: [1, 2]               # post-hoc stop rule
  sg_score_weights:                           # post-hoc SGScore recomputation
    balanced: [0.5, 0.5]
    rel_heavy: [0.4, 0.6]
  hybrid:                                      # fusion of node-confidence + LLM saturation_score
    conf_weight: 0.5
    llm_weight: 0.5
    threshold: 0.5                             # recalibrated for the 0.1 object gate (obj_conf range ~0.1-0.5)

convergence:
  epsilon: 0.02
  k: 3
  min_level: 5

analysis:
  # which methods to analyze "what was missing at the stop level" for
  stop_methods: [oracle, baseline, llm, vlm_single, vlm_sequence]

# VLM + SGG saturation scoring (scaled-down MIRU follow-up, 2026-10-07; scripts/40).
# Same prompt (llm.py SATURATION_PROMPT) and 5-level SGG history as LLM-SGG; condition
# img_single additionally attaches the CURRENT level image (script-11 preprocessing).
# Both conditions (text / img_single) are re-scored with these identical settings.
vlm_sgg:
  output_root: outputs/llm_scores_vlm
  think: false
  json_mode: true
  options:
    temperature: 0
    seed: 42
    num_ctx: 16384             # ~9.2k-token SGG prompts + image tokens + output
    num_predict: 1024
  schema_retries: 1            # re-ask once on unparseable / invalid JSON ...
  retry_temperature: 0.3       # ... at MIRU's original temperature (greedy retry is identical)
  transient_retries: 5
  backoff_base_s: 2.0
  backoff_max_s: 30.0
  request_timeout_s: 300

# ── MIRU stop-method registry + GT-based secondary evaluation (scripts/42) ──
evaluation_extra:
  # llm_sgg_text_* are A1's text-only controls re-run with the same decoding as
  # vlm_sgg_single_* (JSON mode, current EGTR gate 0.1); llm_sgg_*_h5_* / hybrid_{4b,9b}_*
  # are the legacy llm_ablation cache (temperature 0.3, no JSON mode, gate 0.3).
  # Score-directory methods (MIRU llm_scores format: <dir>/<image_id>/level_XX.json
  # with saturation_score). Each key K yields K_k1/K_k2 with llm.saturation_threshold
  # (or a per-method "threshold") and the script-13 consecutive-k rule; keys listed
  # in hybrid_methods also yield hybrid_K_k1/k2 (ablation.hybrid fusion).
  # Recomputing outputs/llm_ablation dirs reproduces llm_ablation_*_stop.csv and
  # hybrid_stop.csv exactly. NOTE: outputs/metrics/vlm_stop.csv is stale (threshold
  # 0.8); vlm_single_* below recompute the same scores at the current 0.70.
  score_methods:
    vlm_single_4b: outputs/vlm_scores/qwen3.5-4b/single
    vlm_single_9b: outputs/vlm_scores/qwen3.5-9b/single
    # A1's 2x2 (scripts/40): same client/settings/input, image on/off only.
    llm_sgg_text_4b: outputs/llm_scores_vlm/qwen3.5-4b_h5_rel_on_conf_on_text
    llm_sgg_text_9b: outputs/llm_scores_vlm/qwen3.5-9b_h5_rel_on_conf_on_text
    vlm_sgg_single_4b: outputs/llm_scores_vlm/qwen3.5-4b_h5_rel_on_conf_on_img_single
    vlm_sgg_single_9b: outputs/llm_scores_vlm/qwen3.5-9b_h5_rel_on_conf_on_img_single
  hybrid_methods: [llm_sgg_text_4b, llm_sgg_text_9b, vlm_sgg_single_4b, vlm_sgg_single_9b]
  # Zero-call LATE fusion of score_methods keys (level-wise mean / min; a level
  # missing in either source scores 0 as in MIRU). Same theta / k / hybrid as above.
  fusion_methods:
    fuse_mean_vlmimg9b_text4b: {sources: [vlm_single_9b, llm_sgg_text_4b], op: mean}
    fuse_min_vlmimg9b_text4b: {sources: [vlm_single_9b, llm_sgg_text_4b], op: min}
    fuse_mean_vlmimg9b_text9b: {sources: [vlm_single_9b, llm_sgg_text_9b], op: mean}
  k_options: [1, 2]
  gt_eval_dir: outputs/miru_gt_eval     # EGTR-vs-VG-GT stage metrics + comparison table
  final_methods:                        # rows of the comparison table (missing -> skipped)
    - baseline
    - llm_sgg_4b_h5_k2
    - llm_sgg_9b_h5_k2
    - hybrid_4b_k2
    - hybrid_9b_k2
    - vlm_4b_single_k2
    - vlm_9b_single_k2
    - vlm_single_4b_k2
    - vlm_single_9b_k2
    - llm_sgg_text_4b_k2
    - llm_sgg_text_9b_k2
    - vlm_sgg_single_4b_k2
    - vlm_sgg_single_9b_k2
    - hybrid_llm_sgg_text_4b_k2
    - hybrid_llm_sgg_text_9b_k2
    - hybrid_vlm_sgg_single_4b_k2
    - hybrid_vlm_sgg_single_9b_k2
    - fuse_mean_vlmimg9b_text4b_k2
    - fuse_min_vlmimg9b_text4b_k2
    - fuse_mean_vlmimg9b_text9b_k2
    - hybrid_fuse_mean_vlmimg9b_text4b_k2
    - hybrid_fuse_min_vlmimg9b_text4b_k2
    - hybrid_fuse_mean_vlmimg9b_text9b_k2

configs/config_heldout.yaml.content:
# Held-out confirmation overlay for the MIRU pipeline (2026-10-08).
# Use: MILESTONE1_CONFIG_OVERLAY=configs/config_heldout.yaml <any MIRU script>
# Deep-merged onto configs/config.yaml by milestone1.config.load_config: every
# setting (scales, bilinear, EGTR gates 0.1/0.005, top-k 20/30, LLM/VLM settings)
# is inherited unchanged; only the image set and the output locations change, so
# no MIRU output is overwritten.
# Image set: ROBOVIS2027 test100 (GT-only selection, seed 42) minus the 4 images
# that overlap the MIRU 100 -> 96 images (data/processed/robovis2027_miru/selection_note.json).
# PRE-REGISTRATION (team-lead approved 2026-10-08, recorded before any held-out score exists):
#   rule      PRIMARY hybrid_fuse_mean(vlm image-only 9b, llm_sgg text 4b), theta 0.70, k=2;
#             secondary fuse_min(vlm image-only 9b, llm_sgg text 4b), theta 0.70, k=2.
#   primary   all 96 images: MAE vs stop_c09 (recomputed from the held-out EGTR L20).
#   compare   stop_c09 <= 18 subset (73 images; reproduces MIRU's selection condition).
#   baselines text 4b alone, image-only 9b alone, hybrid text 4b (+ node confidence),
#             node-confidence baseline, fixed-level curve.
#   GT        R50 / relsg_gt equal-observation deltas on both image sets.
#   inputs    image-only 9b = scripts/11 single mode with MIRU decoding unchanged
#             (temperature 0.3, num_predict 1024, NO JSON mode, unseeded; vlm.num_ctx only
#             sizes the context); text 4b = scripts/40 text condition (vlm_sgg settings).
#             Fusion inputs therefore match the rule as registered on the MIRU 100.
paths:
  selected_images: data/processed/robovis2027_miru/selected_images.json
  degraded_images: data/processed/robovis2027_miru/degraded_images
  gt_scene_graphs: data/processed/robovis2027_miru/gt_scene_graphs
  egtr_predictions: outputs/robovis2027_miru/egtr_predictions
  metrics: outputs/robovis2027_miru/metrics
  llm_inputs: outputs/robovis2027_miru/llm_inputs
  llm_scores: outputs/robovis2027_miru/llm_scores
  figures: outputs/robovis2027_miru/figures
  vlm_scores: outputs/robovis2027_miru/vlm_scores   # read by scripts/11 (default outputs/vlm_scores)

vlm_sgg:
  output_root: outputs/robovis2027_miru/llm_scores_vlm

# ── A2: held-out evaluation block (scripts/42_miru_gt_eval.py --dataset heldout) ──
# Own block, not evaluation_extra: a dict deep-merge would keep MIRU's score dirs.
# Pre-registered (worklog 2026-10-08 00:40): no tuning; theta 0.70, k=2.
heldout_eval:
  selection:                      # pre-registered image set, cross-checked vs paths.selected_images
    from: data/processed/robovis2027/selected_images.json
    split: test
    exclude: data/processed/selected_images.json   # the MIRU 100
  oracle: compute                 # stop_c09 recomputed from the new EGTR L20 (top-10 / top-5, coef 0.9)
  saturating_max_stop: 18         # MIRU kept stop_c09 <= 18; report that subset too (mae_c09_sat)
  legacy_csv_methods: false       # baseline + node confidence from the new EGTR predictions
  k_options: [2]
  score_methods:
    llm_sgg_text_4b: outputs/robovis2027_miru/llm_scores_vlm/qwen3.5-4b_h5_rel_on_conf_on_text
    vlm_single_9b: outputs/robovis2027_miru/vlm_scores/qwen3.5-9b/single   # image-only VLM (script 11 layout)
  hybrid_methods: [llm_sgg_text_4b]
  fusion_methods:
    fuse_mean_vlmimg9b_text4b: {sources: [vlm_single_9b, llm_sgg_text_4b], op: mean}
    fuse_min_vlmimg9b_text4b: {sources: [vlm_single_9b, llm_sgg_text_4b], op: min}
  gt_eval_dir: outputs/heldout_eval
  final_methods:
    - hybrid_fuse_mean_vlmimg9b_text4b_k2   # PRIMARY (pre-registered)
    - fuse_min_vlmimg9b_text4b_k2           # secondary (pre-registered)
    - fuse_mean_vlmimg9b_text4b_k2
    - llm_sgg_text_4b_k2
    - vlm_single_9b_k2
    - hybrid_llm_sgg_text_4b_k2             # "hybrid_4b" comparator (text 4b + node confidence)
    - baseline

# Image-only VLM for the pre-registered rule: 9b single mode only, script-11
# settings otherwise unchanged (prompt, max_image_side 512, request options).
vlm:
  models: [qwen3.5:9b]
  modes: [single]
  num_ctx: 16384   # same as concurrent 9b clients -> no reload; prompt ~0.5k tokens, outputs unaffected

configs/pgsg/rel_det_vg_eval_local.yaml.content:
# Local copy of Pix2Grp_CVPR2024/lavis/projects/blip/eval/rel_det_vg_pgsg_eval.yaml
# (PGSG standard SGDet on VG-150) with every /public/... path overridden.
# Data is produced by scripts/23_pgsg_convert_vg.py; run via scripts/24_pgsg_eval.sh.
# Absolute paths assume repo root /home/kanaoka/usr/github/milestone_1.

model:
  arch: blip_rel_detection_pgsg
  model_type: base_vg

  max_txt_len: 512 # test time
  dump_pred: False
  dump_dir: "/home/kanaoka/usr/github/milestone_1/outputs/pgsg/dump"

  seg_len: 32

  sgcls_on: False
  predcls_on: False

  top_k_ent_label_num: 1
  top_k_predicate_label_num: 3

  finetuned: "/home/kanaoka/usr/github/milestone_1/Pix2Grp_CVPR2024/PGSG-CVPR2024/vg_sgg.pth"

  close_clser: False

  num_coord_bin: 640
  image_size: 384
  cate_dict_url: "/home/kanaoka/usr/github/milestone_1/data/processed/pgsg_vg/categories_dict.json"

  post_proc_cfg:
    ent_ampl_scale: 5.0
    rel_ampl_scale: 2.0


datasets:
  vg_rel_detection_eval: # name of the dataset builder
    vis_processor:
        eval:
          name: "blip_det_image_eval"
          image_size: 384
        train:
          name: "blip_det_image_eval"
          image_size: 384
    text_processor:
        eval:
          name: "blip_caption"
    build_info:
      # url == storage (absolute) so the builder just logs "Using existing file".
      annotations:
        val:
          url:
            - /home/kanaoka/usr/github/milestone_1/data/processed/pgsg_vg/VG-SGG-val.h5
            - /home/kanaoka/usr/github/milestone_1/data/processed/pgsg_vg/image_data.json
          storage:
            - /home/kanaoka/usr/github/milestone_1/data/processed/pgsg_vg/VG-SGG-val.h5
            - /home/kanaoka/usr/github/milestone_1/data/processed/pgsg_vg/image_data.json
        test:
          url:
            - /home/kanaoka/usr/github/milestone_1/data/processed/pgsg_vg/VG-SGG-test.h5
            - /home/kanaoka/usr/github/milestone_1/data/processed/pgsg_vg/image_data.json
          storage:
            - /home/kanaoka/usr/github/milestone_1/data/processed/pgsg_vg/VG-SGG-test.h5
            - /home/kanaoka/usr/github/milestone_1/data/processed/pgsg_vg/image_data.json
      images:
        storage: /home/kanaoka/usr/dataset/vg/images

run:
  task: relation_detection
  batch_size_train: 4
  batch_size_eval: 4
  num_workers: 2

  max_len: 1024
  min_len: 768
  num_beams: 1

  experiments_mode: sggen # sggen sgcls
